items.summary: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

items.summary: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

items.title: CVE-2026-41709 · Broadcom VMware ESX: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
items.summary: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

items.title: CVE-2026-46300 · Linux Kernel: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
items.summary: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

items.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

items.title: CVE-2026-111497 · Google Brotli: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
items.summary: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

items.title: CVE-2026-114625 · Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-106931 · EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

items.title: CVE-2026-96656 · Plex Media Server: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
items.summary: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

items.title: CVE-2026-96655 · Plex Media Server: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
items.summary: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

items.title: CVE-2026-96654 · Plex Media Server: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
items.summary: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

items.title: CVE-2026-96652 · Plex Media Server: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
items.summary: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

items.title: CVE-2026-110936 · Siemens Software Center: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
items.summary: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

items.title: CVE-2026-102764 · BeyondTrust Remote Support: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
items.summary: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

items.title: CVE-2025-61624 · Fortinet Multiple Products: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.summary: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-21589 · Atlassian Multiple Products: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
items.summary: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

items.title: CVE-2026-105134 · Ahsay AhsayCBS: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

items.title: CVE-2026-76519 · Cisco Secure Email Gateway: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

items.title: CVE-2026-105133 · Ahsay AhsayCBS: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
items.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

items.title: CVE-2026-0322 · Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

items.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
items.summary: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.
